title: This Little AI Device Will Print Millionaires
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast

idea.name: AI implementation agency using wearable pendants as a wedge
idea.one_liner: Agency acting as 'modern mechanic' for AI; buy ~10 $100 pendants as lead magnets to get into businesses that rely on verbal communication, then set up automations

key_quotes.quote: I know we've talked about this a few times, but every week it's like I fall more and more in love with the idea of an agency business that is helping business owners implement artificial intelligence.
So you are a needed resource in these businesses.

idea.name: AI scribe service for physicians via wearable pendants
idea.one_liner: Give doctors a recording pendant to try free for two days, then charge ~$1,500/month to replace human scribes with automations that write notes into patient records

key_quotes.quote: You just say like, "It's $1,500 a month and you won't need a scribe anymore and I'll just manage all this for you."
I think there's a world where someone could just buy a dozen of these, 100 bucks a piece, and walk into doctor's office and say, "Hey, here's what this is.

claims.claim: Scribes raise visits from 10 to 15-20 per day
claims.quote: So a physician who could have seen 10 people per day is now all of a sudden able to see 15 or 20 people per day, right?

acquisition_channels.details: walk into clinics with free trial pendants

ideas.other_uk_rules: Health data is special category under UK GDPR; NHS DSPT and clinical safety (DCB0129/0160) standards apply

idea.name: Daily AI updates to families of assisted-living residents
idea.one_liner: Residents wear pendants and families get a daily AI summary of activities, meals and medications, sold as a facility upsell

key_quotes.quote: and you just say to the facility like, "Hey, give this to two of your residents and this could, you know, potentially be an upsell for them

ideas.other_uk_rules: Consent and capacity issues (Mental Capacity Act) and UK GDPR special category data

idea.name: AI sales coaching for in-person field sales teams
idea.one_liner: Door-to-door/field reps wear pendants; transcripts analysed by AI to surface best reps' verbatim tactics, word counts vs sales, and coaching, charged flat or as % of sales lift
idea.customer: pest control, home service, retail and dealership sales teams
idea.revenue_model: flat fee or % of sales increase

key_quotes.quote: You could charge us a flat fee or you could charge a percentage of however much you help increase their sales.
Car dealerships, local local businesses, home service businesses, that's where the greater need is.

idea.name: Pendant-based productivity monitoring for remote employees
idea.one_liner: Mail $100 pendants to remote staff to track performance and give AI recommendations

key_quotes.quote: Why not mail a pendant to your employees? A $100 investment.

ideas.other_uk_rules: ICO employment monitoring guidance and UK GDPR make continuous audio monitoring high-risk

idea.name: AI conversation analysis for marriage therapists
idea.one_liner: Couples opt in to wear pendants; AI summarises tone and dynamics so therapist charges $50/hour more, split 50/50 with the operator

key_quotes.quote: And of that $50 an hour more, you're going to give me half of it, and I'm just going to manage this whole process.

ideas.other_uk_rules: Special category data; explicit consent and strict security under UK GDPR

idea.name: AI deep-research background screening for employers
idea.one_liner: Use deep research/OSINT prompts to vet new hires beyond criminal records for ~$200/month

key_quotes.quote: Why would you not pay 200 bucks a month to have this and do research on new hires?

ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR and DBS rules restrict pre-employment screening; ICO guidance on social media vetting

idea.name: Dollar DR: pay-per-use deep research
idea.one_liner: Website letting anyone run a deep-research prompt for $1 on the host's API, cost ~30-50 cents, for people who won't pay $200/month
idea.customer: occasional users like real estate investors

key_quotes.quote: And anyone can use my pro version API to run deep research prompts on anything they want for a buck.
And my cost on that based on token usage would be 30 to 50 cents.
